content: Gaming keyboards have evolved over the years to add RGB LEDs, extra knobs, and buttons with screens, but one feature has remained fairly consistent: the mechanical switch. That’s slowly changing, with brands introducing adjustable optical switches that are more customizable and have a faster response time. Razer’s Huntsman V3 Pro TKL is a compact, wired option on sale at Amazon for $124.99 (usually $159.99). [Product: Razer Huntsman V3 Pro TKL | https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0CG7BWG7J?tag=theverge02-20] Optical switches constantly read the height of each key, opening up a wealth of new features that traditional mechanical switches don’t support. For example, you can set the activation height for different keys, down to 0.1mm for the lightest touch, or up to 4mm for keys you don’t want to accidentally press at the wrong time, and they can reset without reaching the top height for faster repeated presses. Like some other keyboards with optical switches, you can use a function Razer calls “Snap Tap” to prioritize specific key inputs over each other, letting you rock back and forth between your strafing keys in a shooter, for example. The feature is turned off by default, and is banned in some games like Counter-Strike 2, but can be switched on at the keyboard level or in the Razer Synapse app.

chineseContent: 游戏键盘多年来不断发展，增加了 RGB LED、额外的旋钮和带屏幕的按钮，但有一个功能仍然相当一致：机械开关。随着品牌推出可定制性更强且响应时间更快的可调节光学开关，这种情况正在慢慢改变。 Razer 的 Huntsman V3 Pro TKL 是一款紧凑型有线产品，在亚马逊上售价 124.99 美元（通常为 159.99 美元）。 [产品：Razer Huntsman V3 Pro TKL | https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0CG7BWG7J?tag=theverge02-20] 光学开关不断读取每个按键的高度，从而开辟了传统机械开关不支持的大量新功能。例如，您可以设置不同按键的激活高度，低至 0.1 毫米以实现最轻的触摸，或者高达 4 毫米以防止您不想在错误的时间意外按下按键，并且它们可以在不达到顶部高度的情况下重置，以实现更快的重复按下。与其他一些带有光学开关的键盘一样，您可以使用 Razer 称为“Snap Tap”的功能来确定特定按键输入的优先级，例如，让您在射击游戏中的扫射按键之间来回切换。该功能默认关闭，并且在《反恐精英 2》等某些游戏中被禁止，但可以在键盘级别或 Razer Synapse 应用程序中打开。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于 AI 与科技趋势信号，适合用于观察工具选型、产品机会、开发者关注点和技术路线变化。
